messages:
Priya (Acme): hey team — after the rollout on Mar 1 our assistant started dropping earlier instructions when we include the 20–30k token history. We have a strict 'output as bullet list' instruction at the top of the thread and the model now returns prose and truncates mid-sentence. This broke our workflow for summarization. High impact — live traffic.
maya (support): sorry to hear this, Priya. can you paste a request_id for one failed call and the model name/version you hit? also an example prompt (sanitized) would help.
Priya (Acme): request_id: req_0x9c3f7b. model: redwood-infer-v3.0.1 (the rollout tag said v3.0.*). example payload (sanitized):
```
{"input": "INSTRUCTIONS: produce bullets\n[20k tokens of history trimmed out in email]\nUser: summarize and bullet action items\n"}
```
maya (support): thanks — reproducing now. @liam can you take a look? sounds like a long-context regression post-rollout.
liam (ml-eng): looking. a couple of quick checks: 1) are you hitting hosted API or dedicated pools? 2) what's the observed token count (prompt tokens + expected completion)? 3) any recent prompt engineering that moved instructions to the top vs the bottom?
Priya (Acme): hosted API (us-west). total tokens ~26k (input ~24.5k, expected completion 1.5k). instruction is the very first line of the input. before rollout behavior was correct.
oliver (sre): checking logs for req_0x9c3f7b... seeing an INFO about kernel fallback but no errors. no 5xx. latency is slightly higher for that req (~1.8s/tok) but not huge. attaching trimmed logs:
```
[2026-03-05T12:03:21Z] req_0x9c3f7b model=redwood-infer-v3.0.1 seq_len=24500 kernel=fallback_kv_eviction
[2026-03-05T12:03:22Z] req_0x9c3f7b stage=decoding tokens_emitted=342 status=completed
```
liam (ml-eng): 'fallback_kv_eviction' is interesting — suggests we evicted prefix KV cache during decode when sequence length exceeded some internal buffer. that could cause earlier instructions to be effectively forgotten.
maya (support): Priya — does reducing the context to <=8k restore correct behavior?
Priya (Acme): yes — when we truncate to ~7.5k it works fine. problem only when we feed the full history.
liam (ml-eng): thanks. hypothesizing two possibilities: 1) v3.0.1 changed kv-cache handling or kernel selection thresholds (aggressive eviction) 2) compilation picked a new kernel for long sequences that has a bug in prefix retention. both could cause instruction loss and truncation symptoms.
anna (eng-runtime): pinging runtime. we recently pushed a kernel/selector tweak in rollout v3 that prioritized memory-savers for long sequences on certain GPUs. @deploy-bot can you show the rollout diff for v3.0.1?
deploy-bot: rollout v3.0.1 -> changed kernel_selector: enable_aggressive_kv_eviction=true, fallback_policy=lazy_compact
liam (ml-eng): that flag matches the hypothesis.
oliver (sre): mitigation options for customer while we investigate:
- route their tenant to the previous model variant (v2.9.x) / pin model version
- force the runtime to use non-aggressive kernel selector for their requests (if we can override per-tenant)
- temporary heuristic: refuse requests with total_tokens > 20k with a 4xx and guidance (not ideal but limits breakage)
maya (support): Priya — can we pin you to v2.9.8 for now? we can do that from the console; it should be a config flip and isolated.
Priya (Acme): yes please — would prefer pinning. what's the expected ETA to flip?
maya (support): I can open a customer pin request and ask runtime to prioritize it. ETA ~15–30min to route new traffic once config propagates.
liam (ml-eng): in parallel I'll reproduce locally with a synthetic trace. can you share a sanitized export of the failing prompt (we need the relative positions of instructions and summary target) — can be a small subset if needed.
Priya (Acme): shared sanitized sample in a private ticket (link in DM). also attaching the curl we used to reproduce:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-infer-v3.0.1","input":"INSTRUCTIONS: produce bullets\n<24.5k tokens>\n"}'
```
liam (ml-eng): reproducing now with feed-forward profiler and kv-trace.
anna (eng-runtime): quick note: we have feature flags to override kernel_selector per-tenant; I can apply to Acme if support requests it. but we should avoid manual toggles at scale.
oliver (sre): no infra-level errors, memory within limits. this looks algorithmic. still checking GPU driver warnings for odd mem fragmentation.
liam (ml-eng): reproduced locally. when the aggressive_kv_eviction flag is ON, we see early prefix eviction which causes the attention context to lose the initial instruction and the decoder to start producing off-format output and then stop (decode termination heuristic triggered early). stack trace attached to internal ticket RWD-1452.
maya (support): created support ticket RWD-1452 and added Acme notes + request_id. escalating to eng-ml and eng-runtime. Priya — we've pinned you to v2.9.8 and applied a per-tenant kernel_selector override to disable aggressive_kv_eviction. can you confirm after a few calls?
Priya (Acme): testing now... ok results are back to bullets and no truncation. thank you.
liam (ml-eng): root cause: rollout enabled a kernel selection heuristic that attempts to reduce peak memory by evicting KV for very long contexts; it's too aggressive and doesn't preserve initial instruction state. fix plan: 1) revert the heuristic default in next rollback patch, 2) add regression test that asserts instruction-retention for >20k prefix, 3) add telemetry to detect kv-eviction events correlated with format loss. timeline: quick rollback patch in next 24h, full tested fix in next stable release.
anna (eng-runtime): I'll schedule the rollback rollout and add a canary check focused on long-context instruction retention. also adding a per-tenant opt-out API so customers can pin behavior until fixed.
oliver (sre): creating a monitoring alert for 'kv_eviction_detected' x request_id to catch regressions in future.
maya (support): Priya — summary for you: 1) pinned to v2.9.8 and applied kernel override (should be immediate) 2) workaround validated by you 3) eng teams opened RWD-1452 and will roll back the aggressive flag and add tests. we'll update this thread and your ticket with progress.
Priya (Acme): appreciate the quick turnaround. please keep us in the loop; this is blocking a daily job. :pray:
maya (support): will do. tagging @liam @anna for follow-up. :+1:
liam (ml-eng): following up: adding unit test harness that simulates 25k token prompt + strict output format check. hoping to land fix tomorrow.
anna (eng-runtime): noted; I'll post the rollback PR link in RWD-1452 once created.
deploy-bot: action: pin_applied tenant=acme model=v2.9.8 override=kernel_selector:aggressive_kv_eviction=false
maya (support): closing loop here for now — re-open if anything else pops up.
